products.title: The Swish Collection Bundle
products.body_html:
The Swish Collection bundle gives you all four products for a discounted price, just select your size for The Swisher Zip!

The Swisher Zip brings a little ’90s New York nostalgia, the Swish way. This windbreaker pairs classic navy and heather gray with a relaxed, throwback silhouette.  Nick’s motto “Gotta Be You” is printed subtly along the back neckline - a small reminder that it's better to be a first class version of yourself, than a second class version of somebody else. New York energy is truly about being you and sharing that contagious positivity with everyone you meet.

The Fairway Performance Cap | Home  & The Fairway Performance Cap | Away pair our best selling fairway cap with a pinstripe inspired rope, one of Nick’s favorite touches from the collection. The inside of the cap is custom designed, showcasing Swish's signature, alongside #33 and '09, on the brim and a "World Series Champion" interior lining.

The Founder's Cap | Swish is the kind of hat that feels like it’s been around forever. Classic New York navy, 100% cotton, and a timeless “vintage green” under brim finished with Nick’s embroidered signature alongside #33 and '09,  and a "World Series Champion" interior lining.

products.title: Back '90s Windbreaker | Tux
products.body_html:
RTG is bringing the ’90s back with our new Back ’90s Windbreaker. 

A throwback to an era when golf style had a little more personality. The Back ’90s Windbreaker draws inspiration from the vintage golf and sportswear of our favorite decade, reimagined in NYC through the Read The Green lens. With retro two-tone detailing and a relaxed silhouette, this piece stays true to the unmistakable look of the '90s and moves effortlessly from the course to the city.

Product Details

  • Lightweight performance fabric, wind and water resistant
  • Quarter-zip closure for easy layering
  • Two functional side pockets
  • Elasticized cuffs for a secure fit
  • Adjustable drawstring waistband for a custom fit
  • Please refer to our sizing chart to find your preferred fit.

products.body_html:
Premium Heavyweight Drop Sholder Tee Shirt

Boxy and Slightly Cropped Feel

Read The Green Putt Design Water Printed

Coined “The Misprint” due to a production error where the wrong sample was bulk produced. We asked our community to rank our upcoming releases, and this design was a RTG community favorite.

We trusted our community and released it exactly as they loved it. This is a 1-of-100 limited misprint, never to be made again - a reminder that reading the green means knowing when to embrace the unexpected.
